name: PenCom regulatory framework for licensed pension operators
changelog: Shell pack. Covers the Pension Reform Act 2014, the Regulations for Compliance Officers (RR/P&R/09/03), the Guidelines for Risk Management Framework for Licensed Pension Operators and the Investment Regulation as amended in February 2019. The contents of the risk management guideline are UNCONFIRMED, so the obligations here are shells seeded as draft — filing dates must be researched before use. Every date, threshold and penalty in this pack is drawn from the phase-8 research brief and has NOT been confirmed against the regulator’s primary document. The pack ships unverified: records are usable internally but excluded from generated regulatory submissions until a person verifies them (rule R10).
